items.source: By default, the mappings in the mime.types file located in the same package as this class are used, which cover many common file extensions (in contrast to the out-of-the-box mappings in activation.jar). This can be overridden using the mappingLocation property.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用位于本类同一包中的mime.types文件中的映射，该文件涵盖了许多常见的文件扩展名（与activation.jar中开箱即用的映射形成对比）。可以使用mappingLocation属性覆盖此设置。

items.source:
Needs to follow the mime.types file format, as specified by the Java Activation Framework, containing lines such as:
text/html html htm HTML HTM
items.translation:
需要遵循由 Java 激活框架指定的 `mime.types` 文件格式，包含如下行：
text/html html htm HTML HTM

items.source: Additional mappings can be added via the mappings bean property, as lines that follow the mime.types file format.
items.translation: 可以通过 `mappings` 属性添加额外的映射，其格式遵循 `mime.types` 文件的格式。

items.source: The default implementation creates an Activation Framework MimetypesFileTypeMap, passing in an InputStream from the mapping resource (if any) and registering the mapping lines programmatically.
items.translation: 默认实现会创建一个 Activation Framework `<code>MimetypesFileTypeMap`，传入映射资源（如果有）的 InputStream，并编程方式注册映射行。

items.source:
Specify additional MIME type mappings as lines that follow the mime.types file format, as specified by the Java Activation Framework. For example:
text/html html htm HTML HTM
items.translation:
指定额外的 MIME 类型映射，格式为遵循 Java 激活框架所规定的`mime.types`文件格式的后续行。例如：
text/html html htm HTML HTM

items.source: Return the delegate FileTypeMap, compiled from the mappings in the mapping file and the entries in the mappings property.
items.translation: 返回由映射文件中的映射和 `mappings` 属性中的条目编译而成的委托 FileTypeMap。

items.source: Creates the final merged mapping set.
items.translation: 创建最终的合并映射集。
mappingLocation - 一个 mime.types 映射资源（可为 null）

items.source: mappings - an array of MIME type mapping lines (can be null)
items.translation: mappings - 一个 MIME 类型映射行的数组（可以为 null）

items.source: IOException - if resource access failed
items.translation: IOException - 如果资源访问失败

items.source: Compile a FileTypeMap from the mappings in the given mapping file and the given mapping entries.
items.translation: 从给定的映射文件和给定的映射条目中编译一个 `FileTypeMap`。
